messages:
alex.sales: Quick pass to CS + eng — HeliosGov (mid-market, public sector) signed a trial yesterday. Renewal window ~60d, expectancy to convert if privacy, SSO, and audit webhooks are green. Current blockers: SAML attributes not flowing, webhook POSTs returning 500s to their on-prem collector, and they asked for a Private deployment cost estimate. Putting owners below.

maria.cs: Thanks Alex — assigning myself as CS owner. Success criteria from their side: E2E SSO, webhook reliability <=1% error, and steady P95 latency <200ms for 512 tokens. Do we have sample logs + a direct POC contact?

alex.sales: POC is priya@heliosgov.gov. I filed ticket #12345 and attached the initial sample logs. They reported payloads failing with body: `{"error":"MsgSizeExceeded"}`. Also they flagged encryption-at-rest + KMS policies.

leah.support: I picked up ticket 12345. Quick triage: our proxy is rejecting large audit payloads (limit 1MB). Repro steps and raw payload are in the ticket. Short-term mitigation: ask them to send compressed ndjson or use chunked posts. Long-term: we can bump proxy limit or stream events.

sam.eng: cc @leah.support @maria.cs — I can take the engineering triage. Need a reproducible payload + exact error logs. If we have a repro I can scope: 24h for hotfix config change (proxy bump) or 48h for safer streaming path. Please paste curl repro: 
```
curl -v -X POST https://helios-audit.local/collect -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary @sample.json
```
Attach sample.json to the ticket. If compressed: include `-H 'Content-Encoding: gzip' --data-binary @sample.json.gz`.

maria.cs: Owner matrix for this thread: CS owner = @maria.cs, Support triage = @leah.support, Eng owner = @sam.eng, Sales contact = @alex.sales. Action items: 1) Support attach repro to ticket; 2) Eng evaluate proxy config & propose hotfix; 3) CS confirm KMS/encryption requirements and whether Private deployment is mandatory; 4) Sales to manage renewal messaging (no hard promises).

alex.sales: I told Priya we aim for a 24h hotfix if repro is solid. Also asked for clarity on whether Private is required vs Dedicated with VPC peering. They want an immediate cost delta for Private vs Dedicated.

emily.prod: Emily (Product): ballpark delta for Gov workload: Private onboarding fee ~$25k + infra ~ $8k/mo for expected audit volume. Final pricing needs infra sizing. Tagging @rory.finance for a formal two-option estimate.

rory.finance: Will do. I\u2019ll produce a two-option estimate (Dedicated reserved vs Private one-off) and send to this thread by EOD tomorrow.

maria.cs: Capturing feedback: HeliosGov said the onboarding docs for gov/PII deployments were confusing (multiple KMS paths, unclear required SAML attributes). I\u2019ve logged a docs ticket and CCed docs team to simplify the gov checklist.

deploy-bot: Ticket #12345 created by leah.support. SLA flagged: 24h response requested. :rotating_light: 

maria.cs: Next check-in scheduled for tomorrow 10:00 PT. I\u2019ll update with repro status and eng ETA. Thanks everyone — tagging owners again: @sam.eng (eng), @leah.support (support), @alex.sales (sales), @rory.finance (finance). :thumbsup:
